title: Wall Mount Towel Shelve 3-Tier Hotel Style 24.7-Inch Brass | Glokzin Teal | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add space-saving storage to your bathroom with a wall mount towel shelve that brings hotel-style organization to a traditional bathroom hardware look in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms.

  • Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Brass construction: Crafted from brass.
  • Clean installed look: Concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Ready to install: Mounting hardware included; some assembly required.

Specs

  • Category: Towel Shelves
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Dimensions: 24.7 in L x 8.9 in W x 10.4 in H
  • Projection: 3.5 in
  • Weight: 5.6 lb
  • Included items: Towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
  • , including statement colors
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
